'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[2025 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
***At least 17 people are killed in an attack on a hospital by the [[Allied Democratic Forces]] in [[Lubero]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/islamic-state-backed-rebels-kill-17-in-eastern-congo-hospital-attack/ (AP via CTV News)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]], [[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***Six people are killed and 35 others are injured in a missile and [[drone warfare|drone attack]] by [[Russian forces]] on [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://apnews.com/article/war-russia-ukraine-energy-strikes-bombs-e0016ce1cec36f650e384a255250bf18 (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[El Fasher massacre]]
***The [[United Nations Human Rights Council]] establishes an independent [[United Nations fact-finding mission|fact-finding mission]] to investigate reported [[mass killing]]s and other alleged [[War crimes during the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|war crimes]] by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] and their allied groups in [[El Fasher]], [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/un-human-rights-council-begins-emergency-session-sudan-2025-11-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Nine [[Guerrilla movements in Colombia|guerrilla]] fighters are killed by a [[Colombia]]n [[Military Forces of Colombia|military]] airstrike in the [[Arauca Department]]. [https://www.bssnews.net/international/332068 (AFP via BSS)]
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**A woman is injured in a [[rocket]] attack by unknown assailants on a house in [[Mezzeh]], [[Damascus Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/14/rocket-attack-in-syrias-capital-wounds-one-person (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War on drugs]], [[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers]]
**The [[United States]] [[U.S. Department of Defense|defense department]] announces Operation Southern Spear to target alleged [[narcoterrorism|narco-terrorists]] in [[Central America|Central]] and [[South America]] and the [[Caribbean]] under the [[US Southern Command]]'s jurisdiction. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-announces-military-operation-against-narco-terrorists/a-74737957 (DW)] [https://www.axios.com/2025/11/14/hegseth-southern-spear-venezuela-caribbean (Axios)]
**Four people are killed in an [[United States Navy|American]] [[airstrike]] against a boat in the [[Caribbean Sea]]. The attack is announced today, but was carried out four days ago. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/15/us-confirms-four-people-killed-in-20th-strike-on-vessel-in-the-caribbean (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Saab AB]] signs a contract worth {{Euro}}3.1 billion (US$3.62 billion) with the [[Government of Colombia|Colombian government]] to provide 17 [[Saab JAS 39 Gripen|Gripen fighter jets]] to the [[Colombian Aerospace Force]] over the next five years. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/saab-signs-31-billion-euro-gripen-fighter-deal-with-colombia-2025-11-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tuzla retirement home fire]]
**[[Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnian]] authorities report that a [[short circuit]] from an [[Overvoltage|overburdened]] [[power cable]] in a resident's room caused the deadly fire at a [[Tuzla]] [[retirement home]]. The investigation continues to examine possible [[negligence]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bosnia-fire-death-toll-28fb99e22fbb73b047d30fd04adbc459 (AP)]
*[[2025 Nowgam explosion]]
**Nine people are killed and 29 others are injured after seized explosives detonate inside of a police station in [[Srinagar]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/ammonium-nitrate-confiscated-by-cops-explodes-inside-police-station-in-srinagars-nowgam-casualties-feared-9638701 (NDTV)]
*At least 101 people are killed and others are presumed trapped in a [[landslide]] at a [[Gold mining|gold mine]] near [[Kolwezi]], [[Lualaba Province]], Democratic Republic of the Congo. [https://www.bluewin.ch/en/news/dr-congo-more-than-100-dead-in-landslide-at-gold-mine-2964879.html (blue News)]
*Five [[China|Chinese]] nationals are killed after a minibus loses control and crashes in [[Bali]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/world/bali-minibus-chinese-tourists-crashes-killing-passengers-10365406/?ref=archive_pg (''The Indian Express'')]
*Three people are killed and three others are injured when a bus crashes into a [[bus stop]] in [[Östermalm]], [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/sweden-3-killed-after-bus-crashes-into-bus-stop/a-74753082 (DW)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[World Health Organization]] deploys a team of technical officers and aid to monitor and support an outbreak of [[viral hemorrhagic fever]] that has killed six people in southern [[Ethiopia]]. [https://www.cidrap.umn.edu/viral-hemorrhagic-fever/who-deploys-aid-ethiopia-after-8-suspected-cases-viral-hemorrhagic-fever (CIDRAP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Mali relations]]
**[[Mali]] suspends [[Mass media in France|French television channels]] [[TF1]] and [[La Chaîne Info]] from airing in the country, citing unverified claims and falsehoods in a broadcast on the ongoing fuel blockades by the [[Islamism|Islamist]] militant group [[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-lci-tfi-suspended-violence-armed-groups-fuel-blockade-0c9010cc11a5a60be70a3747e793b0c1 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 Saint Helena Island shooting]]
***A 27-year-old man is arrested and charged with four counts of [[murder]] and possession of a weapon during a violent crime for a [[mass shooting]] that killed four people and injured 15 others at a bar in October in [[Saint Helena Island (South Carolina)|Saint Helena Island]], [[South Carolina]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/south-carolina-bar-st-helenas-island-shooting-man-charged/ (CBS News)]
*[[2025 Islamabad suicide bombing]]
**Four militants linked to the [[Pakistani Taliban]] who allegedly planned the [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] in [[Islamabad]] three days ago are arrested in [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/islamabad-bombing-pakistan-arrests-4-links-to-afghan-cell/a-74741836 (DW)]
*[[Dresden left-wing extremism trial]]
**The [[United States]] declares four [[Antifa (Germany)|Antifa]] groups as [[United States Department of State list of Foreign Terrorist Organizations|Foreign Terrorist Organizations]], including the [[Germany]]-based Antifa Ost, who was involved in the attempted murder of three [[neo-Nazi]] individuals in [[Saxony]] and [[Thuringia]]. The U.S. government is also pursuing action against three other antifa groups in [[Italy]] and [[Greece]], including the [[Informal Anarchist Federation]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-to-designate-germanys-antifa-ost-a-terrorist-group/a-74737299 (DW)]
*[[Mariana dam disaster]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[High Court judge (England and Wales)|High Court judge]] [[Finola O'Farrell]] rules [[Australia]]n mining corporation [[BHP]] liable for the 2015 [[Samarco]] dam collapse in [[Mariana, Minas Gerais|Mariana]], [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]], considered the biggest environmental disaster in the country. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2025/nov/14/london-judge-rules-bhp-group-liable-for-brazil-2015-samarco-dam-collapse (''The Guardian'')] [https://g1.globo.com/google/amp/mg/minas-gerais/noticia/2025/11/14/bhp-acionista-da-samarco-e-parcialmente-condenada-pela-justica-inglesa-em-processo-sobre-rompimento-de-barragem-em-mariana.ghtml (G1)]
*Former rebel leader [[Roger Lumbala]] starts a [[hunger strike]] to protest his ongoing trial over [[War crime|atrocities]] committed during the [[Second Congo War|second war]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], arguing that the [[France|French]] court which judges him does not have legitimacy to try him. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-lumbala-trial-paris-f7fc65ed92eb129f2a5e2a74a63fb4ef (AP)]
*The [[Borgarting Court of Appeal]] nullifies the [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[Støre cabinet|government]]'s approval of three [[Offshore drilling|offshore]] [[Energy in Norway|oil and gas development]] projects due to insufficient assessment of combustion-related [[Climate change in Norway|climate impacts]], but allows production to continue for six months as authorities address the deficiencies. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/norway-government-loses-appeal-case-over-oilfield-developments-2025-11-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Central African general election]]
**The {{ill|Constitutional Court of the Central African Republic|fr|Cour constitutionnelle de la République centrafricaine|lt=Constitutional Court}} rules that incumbent [[President of the Central African Republic|president]] [[Faustin-Archange Touadéra]] may run for another term, after opposition parties submitted that he did not meet the criteria to seek another term in office. [https://apnews.com/article/central-african-republic-touadera-russia-wagner-41891691b35cb17fac75159b78aa0d3e (AP)]
*[[2025 Tanzanian election protests]]
**[[Tanzania]]n [[President of Tanzania|president]] [[Samia Suluhu Hassan]] creates an [[Public inquiry|inquiry commission]] to investigate the killings that occurred during recent [[2025 Tanzanian general election|election]]-related protests and orders the release of some detained participants, while also announcing plans to begin [[Constitution of Tanzania|constitutional]] [[Constitutional amendment|reform]] within [[Suluhu Cabinet|her administration]]'s first 100 days. [https://apnews.com/article/tanzania-election-samia-suluhu-hassan-4076862657677234992ce96b6b2e05fc (AP)]
